Rank 23 - Retail

Agro-Input Shop and Farmer Due Manager

Agro-input shops need stock, farmer dues, seasonal sales, supplier dues, and expiry/batch notes.

Calculate revenue Open overview

Suggested package

BDT 6,000Installation/setup fee
BDT 300Recommended monthly charge

BDT 300/month is practical because agro shops are retail plus advisory hubs.

6.9Practical score based on daily pain, willingness to pay, support load, and expansion potential.
BDT 6,000Default setup used in calculator.
BDT 300Suggested monthly price after support-cost thinking.
BDT 9,600,000Gross year-one revenue at 1,000 businesses.

Why this can work

Target seed, fertilizer, pesticide, irrigation, and feed shops that sell to farmers on cash and due.

Farmer dues and seasonal stock are hard to manage in notebooks.

Know which farmer owes, which product is low, and which season sold best.

Validation signals

  • Farmer base is huge.
  • Agro shops already act as local hubs.
  • Due ledger is daily pain.
  • Expiry/batch matters for inputs.

MVP modules

  • Product stock
  • Farmer profile
  • Due ledger
  • Supplier due
  • Expiry/batch note
  • Seasonal sales report
  • Backup

Do not build first

  • Do not give pesticide advice first.
  • Do not build farmer marketplace.
  • Do not add credit products.

Money model

Change the inputs and see the business case instantly.

Use support cost as a reality check. Low monthly pricing looks attractive until support eats the margin.

First 30-day launch plan

  • Pilot with 10 agro shops.
  • Import product list.
  • Use due collection report.
  • Add seasonal dashboard later.

Risks and fixes

Risks
  • Seasonal usage.
  • Complex products.
  • Low support tolerance.
Mitigations
  • Starter product templates.
  • Simple due screen.
  • Cloud backup upsell.
